_meta.title: Suggestions and decisions
_meta.note: These are suggestions only. Nothing on this list has been implemented beyond what the Findings page says. The 'suggested' label is a recommendation, not a decision.

decisions.question: How should the five submitted links be replaced or confirmed?
options: A. Create one Special Link per product in the Associates account, click it once, and check the destination and the tracking report before using it on the site. Suggested, because it is the only route to a checkable tracking record.
B. Keep the submitted short links as supplied, but still run the test in option A on at least one link.
C. Remove any product whose intended ASIN is not confirmed (see DEC-02).
decisions.suggested: A, then B until A succeeds.
decisions.needs: Access to the Associates account. The requester must run or approve the test.

decisions.question: What is the intended ASIN for each submitted link?
options: A. The requester supplies the 10-character ASIN for each link. The build then checks the official listing and records the confirmation date and source.
B. Accept the observed redirect target as intended. Not suggested: the brief asks for intent, and a redirect is not an intent record.
C. Leave the intended field blank and publish the observed target only.
decisions.needs: The requester's statement for each link.

decisions.question: How should clicks and conversions be measured?
options: A. Use the Associates reports as the first-party source. No new code is needed. Rows enter the campaign ledger only from those reports.
B. Add a privacy-preserving outbound-click counter. This needs a collection endpoint on a host outside GitHub Pages, plus the five event definitions.
C. Both A and B.
decisions.suggested: A now; B only after the five events are defined and a host is chosen.
decisions.needs: The five event definitions and a choice of hosting for any endpoint. Neither is in the brief.

sources.label: GitHub Docs: What is GitHub Pages? (SH-S16)

decisions.question: What is the site's name?
options: A. Keep 'Zone3 Kitchen' as a working name.
B. Choose another name that has been cleared for use.
decisions.suggested: A until a name is chosen.

decisions.question: Which images, if any, should appear?
options: A. Text only (current).
B. Product images supplied through an approved Associates data feed, with attribution.
C. Images from the manufacturer, only with written permission.
decisions.needs: Confirmation of the approved data path under the Operating Agreement.

decisions.question: How often should new guides be published?
options: A. Monthly, one guide a month.
B. Quarterly, four guides a year.
C. Only when a measured question justifies a guide.
decisions.suggested: C, after the first measurement window has data.
decisions.needs: A measured source of search or on-site questions. None exists yet.

decisions.question: Which guide topic should come first?
options: A. 'Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?'
B. 'A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity'
C. 'How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs'
D. 'Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance'
E. A thermometer guide (not yet proposed)
decisions.suggested: Hold until DEC-06 has data. These are working titles, not claims about popularity, search volume or product quality.

decisions.question: Which disclosure wording should appear?
options: A. The exact sentence in Operating Agreement Section 5 (in use).
B. A paraphrase.
decisions.suggested: A. Section 5 asks for the exact sentence or a substantially similar statement.

questions.question: Which ASIN was intended for each link?

questions.how_to_find: Ask the requester (DEC-02). Then check each ASIN on its official listing.

questions.question: Does each link produce a tracked click under the requester's Associates ID?
questions.have: Nothing. No Associates report was available.
questions.how_to_find: Run the DEC-01 test in the Associates workflow and read the tracking report.

questions.question: Does shopnow047c-20 belong to the requester's Associates account, for the marketplace the links point to?
questions.have: The requester's statement of the value.
questions.how_to_find: Check the account settings in the Associates account.

questions.question: Which marketplace should the site serve? The links point to amazon.com. The site's location is Singapore.
questions.have: amazon.com redirects for all five links.
questions.missing: The requester's choice of marketplace, and the matching Associates country.

questions.question: What are the five events to record?
Which price, availability and review figures, if any, may appear on the site, and from which source?

questions.missing: Confirmed approved data path and the current wording of Participation Requirement 2(b), which this build did not re-read.

questions.missing: Search Console data and on-site search logs.
questions.how_to_find: Connect Search Console for the site once it is live (DEC-03 for the analytics path).
